*[Thinking as the farmer — Aunt Wang, 53, Quzhou]*

Well, let me sit down and think about this year. I've been working these 15 mu for thirty years — same fields, I know every corner. My husband and I do most of it; our son works construction in Handan and only helps at the busy times. That's the main thing that shapes what I plant.

Out of my 15 mu, I keep about 12 mu in wheat-maize, the way most people around here do it. The other 3 mu I leave in cotton. Cotton is hard work — lots of picking by hand — but my daughter-in-law helps me in autumn, and it brings cash when I need it. Old Liu next door dropped his cotton two years ago, but I held on because I'm used to it.

**Wheat** — I already put it in last October. Used Jimai 22 seed, same as the village co-op sells, because that's what everyone plants and it doesn't freeze. Before planting I broadcast compound fertilizer, about 40 jin per mu (that's 20 kg) — the 15-15-15 kind from the shop in the township. Now that spring is here, I'll walk the field and look. If it's pale, I topdress urea at jointing — maybe 15 jin per mu, not more because urea went up in price again. I water 3 times usually: green-up, jointing, and grain-fill. The well meter makes me careful. Yield — if the weather is decent, 450 jin per mu is good for me. Last year I got 430 jin, year before was better.

**Maize** — goes in right after wheat harvest in June. The turnaround is tight, only a few days. My neighbor's son has a no-till planter with fertilizer applicator, I pay him 30 yuan per mu to plant. I buy Zhengdan 958, everyone uses it. Fertilizer goes in with the seed — compound, maybe 30 jin per mu. If the summer rains are good, I don't water at all. If it's dry in July, I'll run the well once at tasseling. Maize I normally get around 450-500 jin per mu. I spray once for borer if I see damage on the leaves.

**Cotton** — I plant late April, so in a few days. I buy Bt cotton seed from the shop — the bollworm kind, costs more but saves on spraying. Before planting I spread compound fertilizer, about 40 jin per mu, then topdress urea at bud stage, another 15-20 jin. I still spray a few times for aphids and bollworm even with Bt seed — can't be too careful. Water once or twice if it's dry. Cotton picking starts late August and goes into October, my daughter-in-law and I pick every few days. I usually get 250 jin of seed cotton per mu from my fields.

I don't keep close accounts, but I figure the year's inputs come to maybe 7,000 yuan altogether. Son sends home some money, and his off-farm pay is our cushion — without that I'd cut the fertilizer down.
